title: Where did the money go? Model cost by feature
setup:
import pandas as _pd
_PRICES = {"flash-lite": (0.10, 0.025, 0.40), "flash": (0.30, 0.075, 2.50), "pro": (1.25, 0.3125, 10.00)}
_c = _pd.read_csv("calls.csv")
_cost = _c.apply(lambda r: ((r.input_tokens - r.cached_tokens) * _PRICES[r.model][0] + r.cached_tokens * _PRICES[r.model][1]
                           + r.output_tokens * _PRICES[r.model][2]) / 1e6, axis=1)
_ref_by_feature = {k: round(float(v), 2) for k, v in _cost.groupby(_c.feature).sum().items()}
_ref_hit = float(_c.cached_tokens.sum() / _c.input_tokens.sum())
